1. Position and Business Details

Position Title:

Store Manager

Employing Entity:

Craigieburn Express Pty Ltd (ACN 691 003 960 / ABN 20 691 003 960)

Trading Name:

I Love Dumplings Express

Business Address:

14/330 Brookfield Boulevard, Craigieburn VIC 3064

Nature of Business:

Take-away and quick-service restaurant specialising in dumplings, wok dishes, fried rice, fried noodles and related Asian cuisine

Employment Basis:

Full-time

2. Position Summary

The Retail Manager (General) is responsible for the day-to-day management and commercial performance of I Love Dumplings Express, a take-away restaurant trading from Craigieburn Village Shopping Centre, Craigieburn VIC. The role holds full operational and financial accountability for the store, including product and menu range, stock and supplier management, pricing and promotion, customer service standards, staff supervision, financial record-keeping, budgeting, and compliance with food safety and occupational health and safety obligations. The position requires sound commercial judgement, strong people management skills, and a working knowledge of the quick-service food retail environment.

3. Key Duties and Responsibilities

The Retail Manager (General) is responsible for, but not limited to, the following duties:

Determine the stock levels and service standards for I Love Dumplings Express to ensure the range of dumplings, wok dishes, fried rice, noodles, snacks and beverages offered meets customer demand and maintains consistent food quality and availability across the trading day.
Formulate and implement purchasing and marketing policies, and set prices for menu items, taking into account ingredient costs, supplier terms, competitor pricing and seasonal demand, to protect the profitability of the business.
Promote and advertise the goods and services of the establishment, including planning in-store promotions, social media and local marketing activity, and liaising with delivery platform partners to build the store's customer base and repeat trade.
Sell goods and services to customers and advise them on menu items, ingredients, spice levels and dietary considerations (including vegetarian options), ensuring a high standard of customer service at the counter and for takeaway and delivery orders.
Maintain accurate records of stock levels and financial transactions, including daily sales reconciliation, cash handling, EFTPOS and point-of-sale reporting, and stocktakes of food and packaging inventory.
Undertake budgeting for the establishment, including forecasting sales and controlling food, labour and overhead costs against budget, and reporting on trading performance to the director.
Control the selection, training and supervision of kitchen and front-of-house staff, including rostering, on-the-job training in food preparation, hygiene and customer service standards, and performance management.
Ensure compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and food safety requirements, including those under the Food Act 1984 (Vic) and Council registration conditions, and oversee safe work practices in food handling, storage and service.

4. Skills, Knowledge and Experience Required

Relevant qualification in business, retail management, hospitality management or a related field, and/or at least three years of relevant full-time experience in retail or food service management.
Demonstrated experience in managing product/menu mix, stock control and supplier relationships within a retail or food service environment.
Sound understanding of pricing, budgeting and financial record-keeping for a small to medium retail business.
Proven ability to recruit, train, roster and supervise staff in a fast-paced customer service environment.
Working knowledge of food safety standards and occupational health and safety obligations applicable to food premises in Victoria.
Strong customer service, communication and problem-solving skills.
5. Working Conditions

The position is based at I Love Dumplings Express, 14/330 Brookfield Boulevard, Craigieburn VIC 3064. The role is full-time and may require work across a rotating roster including evenings, weekends and public holidays in line with the trading hours of the business, consistent with standard practice in the retail and food service industry.

6. Remuneration

Remuneration will be paid in accordance with the applicable modern award and/or relevant employment contract, and will meet or exceed any minimum salary threshold applicable under the relevant skilled migration program.

Our client, Gill Family Kitchen, is an Australian family-owned hospitality business specialising in authentic Indian cuisine. Situated in Blackburn, Victoria, the restaurant is dedicated to delivering fresh, high-quality Indian meals prepared using premium ingredients, traditional cooking techniques, and aromatic spices in a welcoming and customer-focused environment. The business offers a diverse menu featuring a range of Indian curries, indo-chinese meals, tandoori dishes, breads, vegetarian specialties, and regional favourites, with a strong emphasis on authenticity, consistency, flavour, and exceptional service

Gill Family Kitchen is currently seeking a skilled and experienced Chef to join their team. The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing and presenting high-quality dishes, contributing to menu development, supervising kitchen operations, maintaining food safety standards, and supporting the continued delivery of exceptional dining experiences while upholding the business's commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

The annual salary for this full-time position is $80,000 to $85,000 plus superannuation.

Duties include:

•	Plan and develop seasonal menus that reflect customer preferences while maintaining the business's quality standards and profitability. 

•	Prepare, cook, and present a wide range of meals in accordance with established recipes and presentation guidelines. 

•	Monitor the quality of ingredients and finished dishes to ensure consistency, freshness, and customer satisfaction. 

•	Estimate food and labour costs and assist with portion control to minimise waste and maximise operational efficiency. 

•	Order, receive, and monitor stock levels of food supplies, ensuring adequate inventory and proper stock rotation. 

•	Supervise kitchen operations during service, coordinating food preparation to ensure timely delivery of meals. 

•	Train, mentor, and supervise kitchen staff in food preparation techniques, hygiene practices, and safe work procedures. 

•	Ensure compliance with food safety legislation, workplace health and safety requirements, and sanitation standards. 

•	Inspect kitchen equipment and work areas to ensure cleanliness, maintenance, and operational readiness. 

•	Collaborate with the Management to introduce new menu items, specials, and improvements based on customer feedback and seasonal availability. 

•	Monitor food preparation processes and adjust cooking methods where required to maintain consistent quality and presentation. 

•	Maintain accurate kitchen records relating to stock usage, food safety, cleaning schedules, and supplier deliveries while supporting efficient day-to-day kitchen operations.

Qualifications:

•	Must have a Diploma of Hospitality Management, a Certificate IV or an equivalent qualification.

•	Should have at least more than one (1) year of experience within a commercial kitchen.

•	Strong knowledge of Indian cuisine, cooking methods, and traditional recipes.

•	Understanding of food safety, hygiene regulations, and kitchen compliance requirements.

•	Excellent teamwork and communication skills.
